# Susan Atelier — Contemporary Indian Occasion Wear

## About
Susan Atelier is a prelaunch Indian occasion wear brand founded by Riya.
Every piece is hand-embroidered by named artisans across 4 ateliers
in Lucknow, Jaipur, Kolkata, and Mumbai. The brand commits to
transparent pricing: each product shows fabric cost, artisan wage,
and MRP breakdown. No fake discounts, ever.

## Products (17 pieces)
- Co-ords (5 pieces): ₹2,800–₹4,500, 18% GST
- Occasionwear (3 pieces): ₹6,500–₹8,800, 18% GST
- Separates (8 pieces): ₹3,200–₹3,500, 18% GST
- Entry (1 piece): ₹1,800, 5% GST

### Materials
Linen, cotton, silk — breathable, natural, chosen to last. Every label
names the fibre. The botanical motifs are drawn from Riya's own garden.

## Transparency Commitment
Every product page shows:
- Maker name and workshop location
- Fabric composition
- Embroidery technique
- Fair wage paid to artisan
- Full cost breakdown vs MRP

## Artisans
- Meena — Lucknow, 14 years at the frame. White cording and seed-pearl botanicals.
- Asha — Jaipur, 11 years at the frame. Dori florals and fine needlework.
- Farida — Kolkata, 17 years at the frame. Velvet and multi-floral zardozi.
- Sara — Mumbai, 9 years at the frame. Pearl setting and final finishing.

## Brand Promise
- One-of-a-kind pieces, already made and finished
- Free size exchange on any piece
- Genuine MRP — no fake discounts, ever
- 100% named makers
- Made by hand in India
